messages:
ana: Heads-up — Brightline Studios reported a big unexpected charge on INV-2026-0423. I did a quick usage reconciliation and it looks like duplicate metering during last weekend's model migration (two identical job_ids processed for the same request set).

kevin: Yikes. Do you have the delta amount?

ana: Charged amount vs expected = $4,813.00. That includes 0.5% tax rounding; base overcharge is $4,810.50. It looks customer hit our higher-capacity routing while jobs were re-submitted.

sam: Thanks. Is this customer on an active contract? Risk of churn?

kevin: Yes — mid-market, eating into Q2 ARR. They already escalated to their AM. Recommending a one-time goodwill credit for the full overcharge + waive potential late fee.

ana: Proposed action: issue credit memo for $4,813.00 against INV-2026-0423 and mark adjustment tag `goodwill:prod_incident_1128`. Also log a manual journal entry to keep accounting ties clean. Snippet: ```create_credit_memo(invoice=INV-2026-0423, amount=4813.00, type=goodwill, memo='duplicate metering during migration')```

lara: I approve the full goodwill credit. We should also confirm we're not missing a bug in the routing logic — loop in eng-runtime if we haven't already.

ana: @jordan (cs) can you notify the customer that we've issued the credit and explain next steps? Offer a 1-month service credit if they're still unhappy. Keep language empathetic. :white_heart:

jordan (cs): On it. Drafting message now — will ping for review.

sam: Accounting question — do we do a straight credit memo in Stripe or a refund? Prefer credit memo to keep ledger clean; customer said they'd like invoice corrected rather than refund to card.

billing-bot: ACTION: Created credit memo CM-7891 for INV-2026-0423 amount $4,813.00. Status: pending application on next billing run. Reference: CM-7891.

ana: Perfect. I'll add `adj_reason=duplicate_metering` and `internal_notes=goodwill_approval_lara_2026-04-23`. Also creating journal entry after CM posts.

kevin: Thanks team. Once CM posts, I'll follow up with the customer and close their escalation.

l ara: small nit — please include the incident id in the customer note so they can correlate with their support ticket. Otherwise approved.

ana: done — customer note prepared and will include incident #1128 and the CM reference. Closing loop after CM posts.

billing-bot: UPDATE: CM-7891 applied to account 35324. Customer balance updated.

jordan (cs): Message sent to Brightline — they appreciated the quick turnaround. :relieved:

ana: Closing thread — will file supporting docs under finance/billing-adjustments and notify GAAP accounting team. Thanks everyone.
